{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnaharness''' was a type of restraint system which used [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] forces to control a being's body. Depending on the configuration, the harness could restrain [[Limb|arms]], legs, hands, feet, or the head. [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] produced the [[MCI-200]] magnaharness during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
